name: Will new energy-efficient windows qualify for tax credits or rebates in California?

mainEntity.name: Will new energy-efficient windows qualify for tax credits or rebates in California?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homeowners in California may be eligible for various local or state incentives when installing energy-efficient windows. While federal tax credits for certain energy-efficient home improvements have varied, it's crucial to check current programs. In California, utility companies or specific cities might offer rebates. It's recommended to consult with your window contractor and local energy agencies to identify any applicable programs and confirm eligibility requirements before making a purchase.
acceptedAnswer.description: New energy-efficient windows in California may qualify for state or local utility rebates; check current programs and eligibility with your contractor and local energy agencies.
